title: Users
searchLabel: Search by email, name or number

identity.unverifiedHint: A number an admin added that the person has not signed in with yet.

create.title: New user
create.description: Add an email address, a WhatsApp number or both: one is enough.
create.descriptionEmailOnly: Add the email address. They sign in with their code, like everyone else.
create.success: Done: they can sign in now.

invitation.emailNeeded: Add an email address to use this option.
invitation.phoneNeeded: Add a number to use this option.
invitation.consent: {{name}} agreed to receive messages from {{app}} on WhatsApp.
invitation.consentWithoutName: The person agreed to receive messages from {{app}} on WhatsApp.
invitation.consentHint: Without this, WhatsApp does not let us message them first.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.onlyMethod: It is their only way to sign in. If you unlink it, they cannot sign in until you add another one.
methods.unverifiedHint: What an admin adds stays “Not verified” until the person signs in with it.

unlink.title: Unlink the WhatsApp of {{user}}?
unlink.descriptionWithEmail: Their open sessions are closed and they can no longer sign in with {{phone}}. They can keep signing in with their email.
unlink.descriptionWithoutEmail: Their open sessions are closed and they can no longer sign in with {{phone}}. Since they have no email, they are left without a way to sign in until you add a number or an email.

form.displayNameHint: Optional. The name shown across the system.
form.rolesEmpty: There are no roles to assign yet.
form.rolesNeedPermission: You need read permission on roles to assign them.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{user}}
deactivate.description: Their access is cut right away: any open session stops working and they can't sign in again until you activate them. Their data stays as it is.

delete.title: Delete {{user}}
delete.description: The account disappears from the listings and can't sign in. Their sign-in history is kept, and if you add the same email again later, the account is restored.

errors.alreadyExists: There is already an account with that email.
errors.phoneAlreadyExists: There is already an account with that number.
errors.lastAdmin: You can't leave the system without administrators. Give the Admin role to another active account and try again.
errors.cannotModifySelf: You can't do this to your own account. Ask another administrator.
